text_573f12e57765: Working time includes the full duty span and documented breaks. Passenger travel is included and shown separately.
text_a915d0043f31: Without exact timing, breaks are calculated at the end and passenger transfers at the start. Sunday, holiday and night (22:00–06:00) figures are provisional; clock changes are not evaluated separately.
text_cc3c8b1a37a8: Receipt of submitted data - not a payroll or collective agreement statement.
